mapper.sql: SELECT d.material_id, SUM(d.putaway_qty * d.unit_price) / NULLIF(SUM(d.putaway_qty), 0) AS avg_price FROM wms_inbound_order_detail d WHERE d.del_flag = '0' AND d.putaway_qty > 0 AND d.unit_price > 0 GROUP BY d.material_id
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(od.actual_qty * p.avg_price), 0) FROM wms_outbound_order_detail od INNER JOIN wms_outbound_order o ON od.order_id = o.order_id AND o.del_flag = '0' AND o.status = '3' INNER JOIN () p ON od.material_id = p.material_id WHERE od.del_flag = '0' AND od.actual_qty > 0 AND o.outbound_date >= #{beginDate} AND o.outbound_date < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.qty * p.avg_price), 0) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN () p ON i.material_id = p.material_id WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.qty > 0

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(i.qty * p.avg_price), 0) FROM wms_inventory i INNER JOIN () p ON i.material_id = p.material_id WHERE i.del_flag = '0' AND i.qty > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wms_outbound_order_detail od INNER JOIN wms_outbound_order o ON od.order_id = o.order_id AND o.del_flag = '0' AND o.status = '3' WHERE od.material_id = i.material_id AND od.del_flag = '0' AND o.outbound_date >= DATE_SUB(#{metricDate}, INTERVAL 90 DAY) )
